portfolioFinding: Official RPM locator still lists these ten El Paso communities; no additional El Paso entries found. Address/phone in existing source catalog match RPM locator except website-level address variations recorded below.
limitations: No demographic data is published by these property sites; Census area-level data must be researched separately.

All ten photo URLs were reached by following image links on official property webpages. Photos have not been visually inspected and reuse authorization was not established. Some official image alt text appears incorrect, so validate visual content before publication.
Ordinary direct HTML requests to the community domains returned403; research used publicly accessible search-tool page content. No bypass attempted.
